Psycho-somatic massage therapy

Renewing the bonds between mind, body and environment

Meet Samar

Welcome to my practice. I work with the spine, fascia and the breath.

My goal is to guide your body into a state of deep relaxation, activating your body’s natural healing processes.

My path into bodywork came through practicing as an artist and academic working at the intersection of biology, philosophy of science and poetry.

I combine techniques that I received from healers and doctors whilst living in India and Thailand.

Alongside working as a psychosomatic massage therapist, I am training as an intuitive herbalist and naturopath, expanding my understanding of how the body can be supported through touch, plants and nutrition.

“The quality of my relationship with clients, even when non-verbal, is deeply rewarding.

Having the honour to help them feel that this space is theirs to unwind in, and that this time is for them to dedicate to catching up with themselves”

Signature offerings

My sessions are rooted in listening, safety, and a holistic understanding of the body. A uniquely tailored session combine elements of Ayurvedic Abhyanga, Thai massage, Deep Tissue work, fascial techniques, Reflexology, Reiki and Abdominal Bodywork. Each treatment is an invitation to understand the body a little more deeply and to support its own process of renewal.

Home Visits

Unwind in your own comfort zone.

I’ll travel with a massage table, premium oils, organic teas and curated scents to your space. The focus is on relaxing and unblocking points of tension in your mind–body–ecosystem. During the summer months this work is most pleasant in the garden. Discounts for couple or group bookings.

Psychosomatic Release

90 to 120 minutes unblocking your spine, fascia and nervous system.

A combination of Deep Tissue & Fascial Techniques encourages lymphatic circulation while calming the nervous system and supporting a sense of balance throughout the body.

Longer sessions allow me to attend to every part of the body, and stay longer on the parts of your body needing focussed work. This approach honours both emotional and physical roots of the tensions you carry. The basis of the session is Abhyanga, which enhances lymphatic and venous circulation, boosting blood flow to skin and muscles. By helping the body to remove metabolic waste and stimulating nutrient flow between cells this technique supports natural detoxification, weight reduction, calming the nervous system and, over a few sessions, improving joint flexibility and muscle tone.

Energetic Reset

Precision work on muscles and natural energy lines to address pain and improve flexibility.

A combination of Thai massage, reflexology and Reiki works to restore the flow of blood and nutrients between muscles, nervous and skeletal systems, bringing vitality back into parts of the body that have hardened through daily life.

Thai massage can be conducted with clothes on and without oil. Stretching and focussed pressing on reflexology points are the main techniques used.

Abdominal detox massage

Chi Nei Tsang — releasing what sinks into the organs.

Inspired by the Taoist practice of Chi Nei Tsang, this treatment focuses on the abdomen with patience and sensitivity.

Drawing on principles from Traditional Chinese Medicine, this treatment is particularly suited to those experiencing persistent abdominal tightness or discomfort that other approaches have not relieved.

Chi Nei Tsang was revived and taught by Master Mantak Chia, who interned with village doctors who started healing any condition by first addressing knots in the abdomen.

The bulk of the session is devoted to finding and releasing emotions or stress that has sunk into the organs, unwinding the consequences for health and balance. Working with acupressure points and meridian networks eases the flow of blood and information between organs.

Seasonal renewal package

A week-long reset to restore digestion and overall balance.

Most of what we call fatigue isn’t tiredness. It’s accumulation, food the body didn’t quite finish processing, stress that never fully passed out of the system, a work–rest rhythm that hasn’t matched the season in months or years.

This package works durationally. Over a week we schedule two hands-on bodywork sessions to prepare the body to release accumulations. A personalised diet plan rooted in whole foods and Ayurvedic seasonal principles supports the cleansing that the bodywork initiates.

A curated selection of Ayurvedic ingredients arrives with guidance on preparation and daily use, from suppliers I know and trust. I’ll be available for follow-up calls to stay updated and suggest adjustments.

Questions
Where do sessions take place?

I work from studios or can conduct home visits across London. Visit me in Croydon or Peckham, separate days for each.

I’ve never had bodywork like this. Is that okay?

Most people come without knowing exactly what they need. We start with a consultation to get ideas of what may need focus before proceeding with a session that goes at your pace. I work with careful awareness, noticing where and how the body is resisting or inviting presence, while giving attention to deep or hidden areas that ask to be acknowledged and worked through.

What are the benefits I can expect?

A deeper appreciation and understanding of your own body is guaranteed within one session. Over the course of a few sessions you can increase capacity for awareness and control of past aches and habits, heightened natural senses, feel lighter from shedding physical accumulations, agility in your loosened joints, loosening the grip of limiting beliefs and emotions.

What happens in a first session?

We talk through what’s going on, then begin gentle hands-on assessment to find where your body is holding and how we can address it.

Is it suitable for everyone?

This treatment may not be suitable if you:

  • Are pregnant
  • Have active infections or inflammation
  • Have certain circulatory disorders
  • Have recent injuries, fractures, or surgery in the treatment area
  • Have uncontrolled medical conditions

A full consultation and health screening will be completed before treatment to ensure it is safe and appropriate for you.

Location & booking

I travel for home visits across South London or further for events. You can visit me in Peckham at Flowstate or in East Croydon at Soulpurpose 360.
